title: Stripe Payment Intents (Events gather + backfill)
description: Read succeeded Stripe Payment Intents. GATHER model: the 'event' table is the HEADER read from GET /v1/events (type=payment_intent.succeeded); the PaymentIntent is its CHILD table 'data', gathered from event.data.object via the existing parentObject mechanism (no data.object-unwrap code needed). Source control is the event 'created' (Unix epoch integer -> fits the bigint RTI) and is expressed as a single field-tied URL prefix (x-rapidi-sourceControl). Use the 'payment_intent' table (List endpoint /v1/payment_intents) as a SEPARATE flat table for the one-time >30-day backfill, since events are retained only 30 days.

context.title: Connection Context
context.description: Connection variables for Stripe REST API.

event.title: Payment Intent Event (gather header)
event.description: HEADER table for the gather. One row per payment_intent.succeeded event from GET /v1/events. Carries only the event envelope: id (evt_...), created (the source-control watermark), and type. The PaymentIntent itself is the child table 'data' (event.data.object), gathered via parentObject - so the header 'created' and the PaymentIntent 'created' never collide (they live on different records).

id.description: Event ID (evt_...). Reference / dedup key for the header row.

created.description: Event creation Unix timestamp. THIS is the source-control watermark (integer, fits the bigint RTI). x-rapidi-sourceControl holds the exact URL fragment emitted before the stored watermark value, tied to this field: the connector sends 'created[gte]=<watermark>' on /v1/events. NOTE: this is the EVENT created, not the PaymentIntent created (which lives on the 'data' child) - watermark on the event clock.

type.description: Event type. Always payment_intent.succeeded here - configured as the query filter type=payment_intent.succeeded (a real /v1/events param, so the existing raw filter passthrough works).

data.description: Holder for the gathered PaymentIntent child. In the /v1/events response each event has data.object = the PaymentIntent; the connector reads it as the child table 'data' (name matches this field). Not a scalar - do not map directly.

links.title: List
links.description: Read succeeded Payment Intent events incrementally. Single service URL for this table (rel=instances). The connector gathers each event's data.object into the child table 'data'.

type.description: STATUS FILTER. Configure a filter type=payment_intent.succeeded. 'type' is a real /v1/events parameter, rendered by the existing raw filter passthrough.

created[gte].description: SOURCE CONTROL. Only return events created at/after the stored watermark. The operator+param are produced from the 'created' field's x-rapidi-sourceControl string; shown here for documentation.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-100).

starting_after.description: Cursor for paging within one run - last event ID from previous page.

data.title: Payment Intent (gathered child)
data.description: CHILD table gathered from the 'event' header. The definition name is 'data' ON PURPOSE: it must match the event's nested 'data' field so the connector's gather (getChildRecords) locates it. Each event yields exactly one PaymentIntent (1:1). The connector flattens event.data.object.* onto this record automatically - no data.object-unwrap code needed. NOTE: for update-type events event.data can also carry previous_attributes; this schema targets payment_intent.succeeded only, where data holds just object.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment Intent (pi_...). From data.object.id.

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents). Divide by 100 for BC.

amount_received.description: Amount that was collected, in the smallest currency unit.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, lowercase. Convert to uppercase for BC.

status.description: Payment Intent status. Always 'succeeded' here (guaranteed by the event type filter).

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the Payment Intent was created (data.object.created). Convert to date for BC Posting Date. This is the PaymentIntent clock, NOT the source-control field (that is the event 'created' on the header).

customer.description: Stripe Customer ID (cus_...). Used to look up BC Customer No.

description.description: Description of the payment. Maps to BC Payment Journal Description.

latest_charge.description: ID of the most recent charge (ch_...). Can be used as BC Document No.

statement_descriptor.description: Statement descriptor shown on customer's bank statement.

receipt_email.description: Email address that the receipt was sent to.

livemode.description: Whether the Payment Intent was created in live mode or test mode.

capture_method.description: Capture method used: automatic or manual.

payment_method.description: ID of the payment method used (pm_...).

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs attached to the object. May contain HubSpot or BC customer references.

payment_intent.title: Payment Intent (backfill / history load)
payment_intent.description: ONE-TIME historical load via the List endpoint (GET /v1/payment_intents). Flat table (records sit directly in the top-level 'data' array - no gather). Use only to seed data older than the 30-day Events retention window; steady-state incremental sync uses the 'event' + 'data' gather. The List endpoint has NO status parameter - filter status=succeeded client/mapping side.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment Intent (pi_...).

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents). Divide by 100 for BC.

amount_received.description: Amount that was collected, in the smallest currency unit.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, lowercase. Convert to uppercase for BC.

status.description: Payment Intent status. Filter status = succeeded (client/mapping side - not a List query parameter).

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the Payment Intent was created. Source-control watermark AND BC Posting Date for the backfill table. x-rapidi-sourceControl sends 'created[gte]=<watermark>' on /v1/payment_intents.

customer.description: Stripe Customer ID (cus_...). Used to look up BC Customer No.

description.description: Description of the payment. Maps to BC Payment Journal Description.

latest_charge.description: ID of the most recent charge (ch_...). Can be used as BC Document No.

statement_descriptor.description: Statement descriptor shown on customer's bank statement.

receipt_email.description: Email address that the receipt was sent to.

livemode.description: Whether the Payment Intent was created in live mode or test mode.

capture_method.description: Capture method used: automatic or manual.

payment_method.description: ID of the payment method used (pm_...).

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs attached to the object. May contain HubSpot or BC customer references.

links.title: List
links.description: List Payment Intents for the one-time backfill. Single service URL (rel=instances).

created[gte].description: SOURCE CONTROL. Only return Payment Intents created at/after the stored watermark. Produced from the 'created' field's x-rapidi-sourceControl string.

customer.description: Optional filter: only Payment Intents for this customer ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100).

starting_after.description: Cursor for pagination - last Payment Intent ID from previous page.
